title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 18
paragraphs: The Persians, then, being the victors over the Ionians in the sea-fight, besieged Miletus by land and sea, undermining the walls and bringing up against it all manner of engines; and they took it completely in the sixth year from the revolt of Aristagoras, and reduced the people to slavery—so that the disaster agreed with the oracle that had been uttered about Miletus.
